local_preparation: Preserve both retained recipients and append the current owner-controlled recovery mailbox. Save a new exclusive CurrentUser DPAPI pending packet, compare exact readback and original unchanged; copy recipient-address JSON only to the clipboard. No provider keys are copied.
recovery_mailbox_input: Same verified account in the existing recovery tab; provided in chat, not republished
idempotence: An explicitly selected pending three-address packet with this mailbox already present can recopy its recipient JSON without creating another packet. Other baseline shapes refuse preparation.
clipboard_data: The three-recipient JSON array only, intentionally used as the value for one reviewed staging setting. Paste before copying console output.

manual_following_action.new_value: Prepared private recipient JSON; two retained addresses plus the current recovery mailbox
manual_following_action.later_or_unrecorded_recipient_edits_not_: Prepared JSON preserves the retained two; review any separately retained later recipient additions before replacing a live value.
manual_following_action.deployment: After the setting is saved, deploy the exact accepted trusted-browser ZIP again so the next deployment uses it; provide new deployment URL. No new ZIP build or SQL upgrade.
